data.author: Aladhi
data.description:
Opening Range Breakout (ORB): marks the opening range of each session (high, low and mid), highlights it green/red when its mid is above/below the previous session, draws breakout signals and projected targets (first target at a % from the mid-range, next ones spaced by a % of the range width). Optional session moving average.

Default session starts at 00:00 UTC; enable the custom session for a market open (eg. 0930-0945 UTC-5).

Based on "Opening Range with Breakouts & Targets" by LuxAlgo, licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/). This port is shared under the same license.
